purpose: Independent original-source ownership controls for the cuff replacement underlay regression; no expected pixel is sampled from the repair.

provenance.positive_contract: Decode the selected original trousers and lower-source stack, apply the exact approved pose once, verify original opaque coverage, then require candidate alpha255 at every point.
provenance.exact_contract: At these three pure-underlay controls the approved posed original jacket and both hands have zero alpha. Candidate RGBA must equal the independently decoded and posed original lower stack.
provenance.exterior_contract: Original source underlay and the approved baseline/rejected candidate are transparent at these eight controls; candidate alpha must remain zero.
provenance.avatar_exposure_contract: These four outer-sleeve points are original avatar skin beneath approved jacket cloth. Restoring their alpha from bare avatar is not acceptable sleeve coverage; keep this ownership distinct from the trouser-positive component.

provenance.positive_contract: Every frozen point has independently posed original jacket coverage. Retain that coverage beneath the fitted antialiased sleeve and approved hands, then the selected trousers. Opaque original-jacket controls with rejectedalpha0 must match the original source exactly; no fitted source contaminates those controls.
provenance.antialias_contract: Three top-seam controls have rejectedalpha0 and zero original trousers/hands; compare their complete RGBA with the independently posed original jacket, retaining source antialiasing.

frozen_seam_corridors.method: From immutable 442 wrist registrations and original independently posed jacket alpha, take native raster cells on the torso side of the old source seam or the cubic registered sleeve-to-wrist inner boundary through the original cap bottom; retain only original-jacket-covered cells whose rejected finished alpha is less than255. Half-open runs are[y,x0,x1]. No repaired pixel contributes to the domain.
